## Contract

- Implement server/discover with supported versions, capabilities, extensions, and server identity.
- Require and validate io.modelcontextprotocol/protocolVersion and clientCapabilities in request _meta.
- Accept request-local clientInfo and return serverInfo in result _meta.
- Return UnsupportedProtocolVersionError and MissingRequiredClientCapability with current allocated codes.
- Add required resultType complete and input_required handling while treating older omitted resultType as complete only inside the compatibility adapter.
- Remove runtime dependence on initialize and notifications/initialized.
- Keep deterministic capability ordering and one SDK-owned schema for CLI, MCP, tests, contracts, and docs.
Stateless MCP core: request-local version and capabilities, mandatory server/discover, typed result envelopes, and deterministic identity
Implement the 2026-07-28 base protocol model in SDK-owned contracts and replace initialize-scoped behavior with per-request metadata and mandatory discovery.

server/discover is mandatory and deterministic with exact supported versions, capabilities, extensions, and identity; Every request validates request-local protocol version and client capabilities and every result identifies the server; Unsupported versions, missing capabilities, malformed metadata, and header mismatches return the specified structured error codes; Ordinary results include resultType complete and compatibility treatment of omitted resultType is isolated and tested; No behavior depends on initialize or notifications/initialized state; The public pm SDK exposes transport-neutral negotiation, discovery, metadata validation, and result-envelope primitives
Make every request self-describing and every server capability discoverable without connection-local initialization
Hosts can negotiate, retry, load-balance, and cache safely across independent requests
The current server hardcodes 2025-06-18 and retains initialize state that the 2026-07-28 core removes
